evidence.note: applied is O.exists(resolution, superseded proposalId match), so applied implies settledDisposition is Some.

CandidateComparison sets resolved = O.isSome(settledDisposition) and actionsDisabled = resolved || reviewBusy || waiting, then passes disabled={actionsDisabled}. applied therefore implies disabled; applied-and-enabled is never constructed.

notes: Expands ProposalCard seed [disabled, selected] with applied. selected stays independent; six tuples remain after dropping applied&&!disabled.

disqualifier.note: Leftover ReviewDialog pair after the reason-gates seed. open is dialog visibility; supersession is O.isSome(selectedProposal) reject-vs-supersede mode. Close keeps the proposal, so closed-with-supersession is legal; mixed pairs are ordinary.
